flagged.title: Context: Science, Ethics & Dystopia
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly instructs students that the exam question is split into two 20-mark parts and that AO4 assesses context which must be blended into both answers, when context is not assessed at all on this question and AO4 is technical accuracy (SPaG).

mark_affecting.quote: Part A asks you to analyze a printed extract for 20 marks, and Part B asks you to write about the wider text for another 20 marks... AO4, understanding context, they are required across both parts... save your context for the wider essay, you have to blend them.

flagged.title: Donations & the Ending
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly places Tommy's river metaphor into the novel's final scene at the Norfolk fence, teaching students the wrong textual sequence and setting for one of the novel's key symbols.

mark_affecting.quote: Standing there, she imagines his beautiful, heartbreaking metaphor: Two people in a fast-moving river, trying so hard to hold on to each other, but the current is just too strong and they're torn apart.
